title: Litigation Readiness
description: Two-metric litigation readiness record: Repository Completeness (workflow/document completeness) and Evidentiary Strength (claim support quality). These scores are workflow indicators ONLY — they do not predict legal outcomes.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 date of this readiness snapshot.

disclaimer.description: Required disclaimer clarifying that scores are workflow indicators, not legal outcome predictions. Must be present in every instance.
disclaimer.const: These scores reflect workflow completeness and evidence quality only. They are not legal outcome predictions and do not constitute legal advice.

repository_completeness.description: Checklist-based score measuring whether workflow components, documents, and structural elements are present and organized.

label.description: Human-readable label: Complete (90–100), Near Complete (70–89), Partial (50–69), Incomplete (<50).

case_directory_structure.description: Score out of 10: all required folders exist.

evidence_index.description: Score out of 15: evidence items registered with required metadata.

chain_of_custody_metadata.description: Score out of 15: provenance fields populated on all evidence items.

claim_ledger.description: Score out of 15: claims stated and mapped to evidence IDs.

evidence_request_register.description: Score out of 10: outstanding requests logged.

chronology.description: Score out of 10: timeline populated with evidence-sourced events.

correspondence_log.description: Score out of 10: inbound and outbound correspondence recorded.

deadlines_tracker.description: Score out of 10: known deadlines logged.

audit_trail.description: Score out of 5: Audit/ folder contains generation receipts.

gaps.description: List of identified workflow gaps reducing the completeness score.

evidentiary_strength.description: Substantive assessment of how well the case claims are supported by documented, authenticated evidence.

label.description: Human-readable label: Strong (85–100), Moderate (65–84), Developing (45–64), Insufficient (<45).

claims_supported.description: Score out of 30: percentage of claims with supported status.

claims_partially_supported.description: Score out of 15: partial credit for partially supported claims.

evidence_authenticity.description: Score out of 20: percentage of evidence with authenticity_status: verified.

evidence_verification.description: Score out of 15: percentage of evidence with verification_status: verified.

missing_evidence_resolved.description: Score out of 10: percentage of missing evidence gaps that have been filled.

source_diversity.description: Score out of 10: evidence draws from multiple independent sources.

gaps.description: List of identified evidentiary gaps reducing the strength score.

notes.description: Additional context or narrative for this readiness snapshot.
